title: Flex Says Axiom Spin-Off on Track for Calendar Q1 2027
summary: Flex introduced Axiom, its planned cloud and power spin-off, at its November 10 Innovation Day and said the separation is on track for calendar Q1 2027.
body_markdown:
In a[second presentation filed the same day](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/866374/000119312526454502/d150156dex991.htm) , Flex said it is on track to complete the planned spin-off of Axiom in calendar Q1 2027, establishing two focused, independent public companies. The filings' legal notices also refer to an agreement under which GC Venture XIII (ASI), L.P. and other investors agreed to collectively purchase 200,000 shares of Axiom's Series A Convertible Preferred Stock in a private placement.


Michael Hartung, named in the presentation as Chief Executive Officer, set out the investment case for Flex after the spin-off. The presentation cites $21 billion in fiscal 2026 net sales from the Regulated Manufacturing Solutions and Integrated Technology Solutions segments, 110,000 employees and operations in 30 countries.


## Why It Matters for FLEX


Flex said the separation creates two companies: an advanced manufacturing business serving healthcare, industrial, automotive, communications and lifestyle markets, and Axiom, which the company describes as a leader in critical digital infrastructure for AI data centers and mission-critical applications. The company said each would be purpose-built for its market, with capital and focus directed to where each business has the strongest right to win. Flex noted that it previously executed the Nextracker spin-off.
